title: Isandro and the Static
author: Ansel Galloway
blurb: Sable Dravenmoor, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
